Professor Marat Khaikin is a legend in the world of colorectal surgery and a leading expert in laparoscopic and bowel surgery and proctology in Israel. His experience, spanning more than two decades, not only guarantees the highest level of professionalism but also makes him a source of knowledge for many younger specialists seeking to advance their skills.

Professor Khaikin stands at the forefront of medical innovation. He is one of the few surgeons to have successfully introduced transanal minimally invasive surgery (TAMIS) into his practice. This pioneering technique makes it possible to operate on the rectum with minimal surgical intervention. Dr Khaikin has not only mastered the method but also teaches it to other doctors, sharing his experience and advanced knowledge.

Building his practice on a combination of traditional methods and innovative approaches, Dr Khaikin offers his patients the best of both. His ability to adopt the newest technologies and techniques allows him to offer patients optimal treatment, which in turn leads to faster recovery and a minimal risk of complications.

Dr Khaikin also has an unusual gift for communication, speaking three languages fluently: Hebrew, English and Russian. This allows him to establish rapport easily with patients of various backgrounds, ensuring comfortable and understanding communication throughout treatment.

EDUCATION

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD), Grodno State Medical University, Belarus
  • Specialisation in general surgery at the Soroka medical centre, Beersheba, Israel
  • From 2005 to 2007, accredited clinical specialisation in bowel surgery, proctology and minimally invasive surgery of the bowel (small intestine, colon, rectum) and pelvic floor in the colorectal surgery department of the Cleveland Clinic, Florida, USA
  • Fellowship in colorectal surgery in the surgical department of the Chaim Sheba medical centre, Israel
  • Certified fellowship in performing colorectal operations with the da Vinci Surgical System, Strasbourg, France

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association (IMA)
  • Israel Surgical Association (IAS)
  • Israel Association of Endoscopic Surgery (IESA)
  • Israel Association of Colorectal Surgery (IACS)
  • American Society of Colon and Rectal Surgeons (ASCRS)
  • Society of American Gastrointestinal and Endoscopic Surgeons (SAGES)
  • American College of Surgeons (ACS)
  • American Medical Association (AMA)

Plastic surgeon

Main areas of specialisation

  • Reconstruction of the tissues of the face and body
  • Correction, augmentation or reduction of the breasts
  • Removal of fat deposits on the abdomen, thighs, buttocks and upper arms (liposuction)
  • Scar removal
  • Removal of birthmarks
  • Forehead surgery
  • Neck lift
  • Reshaping of the nose
  • Correction of the nasal septum (rhinoplasty and septoplasty)
  • Paediatric plastic surgery (repair of cleft palate, cleft lip and others)

Summary

Dr Meir Cohen is one of the best-known and most advanced plastic surgeons in Israel. He holds an MD-PhD and a master's degree in plastic surgery. Chairman of the Israel Association of Plastic Surgeons, Dr Cohen has performed more than 2,000 successful surgical and cosmetic procedures, bringing his patients both joy and beauty.

Meir Cohen specialises in reconstruction after injury and illness, maxillofacial surgery, breast augmentation and reduction, face lifts, abdominoplasty and the removal of scars and birthmarks. He gives particular attention to paediatric plastic surgery. Dr Cohen uses the most innovative technologies and techniques, making plastic surgery more accessible and more widely used.

He is the author and co-author of more than 200 research papers on innovative methods in plastic surgery, and of book chapters on wound healing, facial reconstruction and laser technologies in plastic medicine. Alongside his clinical practice, Dr Cohen is actively engaged in research and academic work, teaching plastic surgery in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University.

Additional specialisation

  • Facial skin lifting
  • Full and endoscopic face lifts
  • Laser peeling
  • Treatment of vascular malformations and skin lesions

Education

  • School of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in craniomaxillofacial surgery
  • Specialisation in paediatric plastic surgery
  • Fellowships at major clinics in the United States and Canada

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations

  • Israel Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
  • American Association of Plastic Surgeons
  • American Academy of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
  • Ontario surgical association, Canada

Nephrologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Clinical nephrology
  • Treatment of acute and chronic kidney disease
  • Treatment of pyelonephritis
  • Treatment of tubulointerstitial nephritis
  • Treatment of glomerulonephritis
  • Care after kidney transplantation
  • Treatment of high blood pressure
  • Dialysis

Summary: Dr Meital Shaked is a well-known specialist in nephrology. A doctor with 35 years of clinical experience, she is a distinguished figure in Israeli healthcare, with an excellent grounding and fellowships at clinics of international renown.

She specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of kidney conditions such as renal failure of various causes, hydronephrosis, ischaemic kidney damage, occlusion, stenosis or thrombosis of the renal artery, renal vein thrombosis, acute vasculitis, acute and bacterial pyelonephritis, diabetic nephropathy, renal amyloidosis, kidney cysts and polycystic kidney disease, renovascular hypertension and many other renal disorders.

She is an expert of international standing in nephrology and dialysis.

Dr Shaked is an excellent diagnostician, and patients come to her constantly both from Israel and from abroad, including the former Soviet states. Her rich experience and deep medical knowledge allow her to detect kidney cancer and other dangerous conditions accurately at the earliest stage. Thanks to her timely intervention, hundreds of patients have kept a kidney, and thousands have been rid of various disorders completely and without after-effects. The second opinion she gives has often proved decisive, helping to correct treatment that was mistaken or too radical.

In her daily practice Dr Shaked uses the most advanced diagnostic techniques, such as DMSA scanning, which detects kidney disorders more than 20 per cent more effectively than ultrasound, high-resolution MRI, angiography of the renal vessels and many others.

Patients speak very warmly of Meital Shaked, noting not only her high professionalism but also her personal qualities, her willingness to help and her ability to communicate with adult and elderly patients and with children of all ages alike.

She is seriously engaged in research and has more than 40 publications on kidney disorders. She presents regularly at international medical congresses, and her talks always attract great interest from colleagues abroad.

Education:

  • Faculty of medicine, university in Krasnodar, Russia
  • Residency in internal medicine at the Ichilov medical centre, Israel
  • Residency in nephrology at the Ichilov medical centre, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Society of Nephrology
  • European Renal Association

Spinal surgeon
Experience: more than 15 years

Main areas of specialisation

  • Minimally invasive and microsurgical operations on the spine
  • Correction of complex spinal deformities
  • Fixation operations on the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine
  • Surgical treatment of scoliosis and kyphosis
  • Removal of spinal tumours and metastases
  • Surgical treatment of degenerative spinal disease and spinal injury
  • Operations for spinal canal stenosis
  • Repair of spinal fractures

Summary

Dr Morsi Khashan is a highly qualified spinal surgeon of international standing and a senior physician in the spinal surgery department of the Ichilov medical centre. He is a leading specialist in treating complex spinal disorders, including the correction of deformities, microsurgical interventions and the treatment of tumours and injuries.

Dr Khashan performs unique operations aimed at restoring the function of the spine. One of his best-known cases was the first operation in Israel to straighten a cervical hump, carried out together with Dr Zvi Lidar. Through this highly complex intervention, which lasted 12 hours, Dr Khashan restored the quality of life of a 17-year-old patient, correcting a significant curvature of the spine and improving the patient's general condition.

Dr Morsi Khashan is actively engaged in research and teaching, passing his knowledge on to students and interns in Israel, the United States and Canada. He speaks regularly at international conferences and publishes his research in specialist medical journals.

Education and clinical experience

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD), Hebrew University of Jerusalem
  • Internship in orthopaedic surgery, Wolfson hospital, Israel
  • Specialisation in orthopaedic surgery, Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv
  • Specialisation in spinal deformities, Johns Hopkins hospital, Baltimore, USA
  • Research fellowship, University of California orthopaedic surgery, San Francisco, USA
  • Fellowship in spinal surgery, Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv
  • Senior physician, spinal surgery department, Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv
  • Head of the spinal deformity unit, Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv

Academic and research work

Dr Khashan is actively engaged in research in orthopaedics and spinal surgery. His publications address minimally invasive treatment methods, the correction of complex spinal deformities and the use of modern technology in surgery.

He also teaches, training students and interns in Israel, the United States and Canada.

Membership of professional associations

  • Israel Spine Surgery Association
  • AO Spine, the international scientific community of spinal specialists
  • North American Spine Society (NASS)

Conditions Dr Khashan treats

  • Scoliosis
  • Kyphosis
  • Disc protrusions
  • Herniated disc
  • Spinal cancer
  • Spinal fractures
  • Complex spinal deformities
  • Spinal canal stenosis
  • Spondylosis

Dr Morsi Khashan is a name associated with the highest level of professionalism and a responsible approach to patient care. His work helps restore health and a full life to people with severe spinal disorders.

Endocrinologist
Main areas of work:
Dr Naomi Weintrob is a leading paediatric endocrinologist and head of the endocrinology and metabolic disorders unit at the Dana children's hospital. She specialises in:

  • Treatment of diabetes in children
  • Growth disorders
  • Disorders of sexual differentiation and sexual development
  • Treatment of disorders of the endocrine system
  • Treatment of obesity in children
  • Treatment of malignant tumours of the endocrine system
  • Congenital disorders of steroidogenesis

Education and specialisation:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, specialising in endocrinology
  • Faculty of Medicine, Technion, Haifa, specialising in paediatrics
  • Medical centre in New York — research on blood disorders
  • Institute of Paediatric and Adolescent Endocrinology, Beilinson hospital, Israel
  • Hospital for Sick Children, University of Toronto, Canada — advanced training in paediatric endocrinology

Clinical experience:
Dr Weintrob heads the department of paediatric endocrinology and metabolism at the Ichilov hospital. Professor Weintrob also teaches in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University, lecturing on family medicine and adolescent medicine. She is the author of more than 60 presentations at scientific conferences and seminars and has 58 publications in medical journals. She has more than 20 years of professional experience.

Haematologist, haemato-oncologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Leukaemia
  • Blood cancers
  • Hairy cell leukaemia
  • Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia
  • Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia
  • Acute myeloid leukaemia
  • Cancer of the lymph nodes (lymphoma)
  • Hodgkin lymphoma
  • Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
  • Myeloma
  • Blood cancer

Summary:

Dr Odelia Gur is a leading Israeli haematologist and haemato-oncologist and a specialist of international standing in the treatment of malignant blood disorders. She heads the day haematology department and the emergency care unit of Israel's largest medical centre in Tel Aviv, which also includes an outpatient haematology department, a department for the treatment of leukaemias with a unit for hypercoagulation, and a laboratory for stem cell apheresis.

Over many years she has undertaken fellowships and advanced training at major medical centres in Israel and the United States. In her long practice she has repeatedly been recognised by the Ministry of Health as specialist of the year. She has more than 20 years of professional experience.

Additional specialisation:

  • Bone marrow biopsy
  • Radiation therapy
  • The newest «Trojan horse» technology
  • Bone marrow transplantation

Education:

  • Fellowships and advanced training at prestigious medical institutions in Europe and the United States

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association (IMA)
  • Israel Haematology Association (IHA)
  • American Society of Hematology
  • European Hematology Association (EHA)
